Elena — thanks for the packet and the quick turnaround. A few notes from Redwood’s side:

1) DPA execution: we prefer DocuSign for traceability. If you can send a DocuSign envelope (recommended), Legal will countersign. Otherwise a signed PDF is acceptable but will take an extra step.

2) SOC2: the attached PDF is fine, but our security team prefers a hosted copy (read-only link) to verify the control mappings. If you can provide the hosted SOC2 URL (or temporary S3 link), that speeds acceptance.

3) Subprocessors: we require a current CSV with columns: service, vendor legal name, location (country), data processed, and contact. The attached CSV looks close — Laura, can you confirm it fits our governance schema?

4) PO requirements: Finance needs: vendor legal name as it appears on W-9, remit-to address, AP contact (email), and invoice cadence. W-9 is required before Finance issues the PO.

Timeline we’re proposing: DPA executed within 48 hours (DocuSign preferred), SOC2 hosted link within 72 hours, W-9 received now (you already attached — thanks), PO issued within 5 business days after W-9 + DPA. If that diverges from your internal process, flag it.

Laura — I’m assigning PO routing to you; Grace, can you take the security acceptance once we have the hosted SOC2 link?

Thanks, and I’ll circulate the DocuSign path once Legal confirms the DPA text.

— Aditya Rao
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
